pages.text: Trolls are silicon-based beings. Their brains work better in the cold — literally. A troll on a frozen mountain can be a philosopher.$(br2)The same troll in the desert can barely walk.

There are ten known troll materials: stone, ice, deepslate, sandstone, mud, granite, calcite, obsidian, Nether, and diamond.$(br2)$(7)Note: calcite trolls are sometimes called "trolls de calcinha" in Portuguese — the pun is inevitable.
Diamond trolls are extraordinarily rare (0.5% of all trolls). Their intelligence is constant and suffers no thermal penalties.$(br2)If you find one, $(italic)listen$().
